migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC migration programme governance: appoint programme lead, define RACI, secure executive sponsorship, and document scope covering the four cryptographic assets (RSA-2048 TLS, ECDSA P-256 API auth, RSA-3072 key wrapping, ECDH P-256 key exchange).

Perform comprehensive cryptographic inventory and CBOM (Cryptography Bill of Materials) discovery across all applications, services, certificates, keys, and protocols; classify data sensitivity and retention periods to identify 10-15 year confidentiality requirements.
prerequisites: Access to configuration management databases and certificate inventories

migration_steps.activity: Conduct quantum risk assessment and harvest-now-decrypt-later (HNDL) exposure analysis: map long-lived sensitive data flows, identify which assets protect data with 10-15 year confidentiality requirements, and rank assets by HNDL risk and migration complexity.
prerequisites: Data classification and retention policy documentation
Regulatory obligations mapping (e.g., data protection, banking secrecy)

migration_steps.activity: Engage Thales in writing to obtain confirmed PQC support status for Luna Network HSM 7: request written confirmation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA support, firmware version requirements, FIPS validation status, delivery timeline, and upgrade path. Do not assume support until written confirmation is received.
prerequisites: Defined technical requirements for HSM PQC capabilities

migration_steps.activity: Engage third-party core banking platform vendor in writing to obtain PQC compatibility confirmation and migration roadmap: request written statement on ML-KEM/ML-DSA support, TLS/crypto library versions, API authentication mechanisms, key wrapping capabilities, and timeline for PQC-ready releases.
prerequisites: Defined integration requirements for core banking platform

migration_steps.activity: Develop hybrid cryptography strategy and target architecture: define hybrid ML-KEM+ECDH for key establishment and hybrid ML-DSA+ECDSA for signatures, specify crypto-agility requirements, and produce architecture decision records. Align with NIST and industry guidance (e.g., NSA CNSA 2.0, ETSI).

Procure non-production laboratory environment for PQC testing: acquire software-based PQC libraries (e.g., OpenSSL 3.x with ML-KEM/ML-DSA, BoringSSL, or equivalent), test HSM simulator if available, and set up isolated lab network. Do not procure production HSM firmware until vendor confirmation.

Conduct non-production lab testing of ML-KEM for key establishment: test hybrid ML-KEM+ECDH handshakes for TLS and internal secure channels, measure performance, validate interoperability with software libraries, and document results. ML-KEM is used for key establishment only.

Conduct non-production lab testing of ML-DSA for digital signatures: test hybrid ML-DSA+ECDSA for internal API authentication, validate signature generation/verification performance, and assess integration with API gateways. ML-DSA is used for digital signatures only.

Evaluate HSM PQC readiness based on Thales written response: if confirmed, plan firmware upgrade and lab validation; if unconfirmed, document blocker and develop interim software-based key establishment/signature strategy for non-HSM-dependent channels. Do not schedule production HSM firmware upgrade without written confirmation and validated firmware.

Develop detailed migration runbooks and rollback plans for prioritized assets: focus first on RSA-3072 key wrapping protecting long-lived database encryption keys (highest HNDL exposure), then ECDH P-256 internal channels, then RSA-2048 TLS, then ECDSA P-256 API auth. Include hybrid transition states and crypto-agility mechanisms.

Obtain operational approvals and change management sign-off for production migration plan, including risk acceptance for hybrid cryptography, regulatory notification if required, and confirmation that no production changes will occur during the change freeze (2026-12-01 to 2027-01-15).
prerequisites: Vendor confirmations received or blockers formally documented

migration_steps.activity: Execute non-production integration testing of prioritized migration approach for RSA-3072 key wrapping replacement: test hybrid ML-KEM+ECDH or ML-KEM-based key encapsulation for database encryption key protection in lab/staging environment. This is non-production and permitted during freeze if lab policies allow.

During change freeze (2026-12-01 to 2027-01-15): continue permitted non-production activities only — vendor engagement follow-ups, documentation updates, lab testing where internal policies permit, and planning for post-freeze production changes. No production cryptographic changes, HSM firmware upgrades, or major application deployments.
prerequisites: Non-production lab activities approved by internal policy

migration_steps.activity: Post-freeze: execute production migration of highest-priority asset (RSA-3072 key wrapping for long-lived database encryption keys) using hybrid ML-KEM approach, contingent on HSM vendor written confirmation and validated firmware, or approved software-based alternative. This step must not begin until all prerequisites are satisfied.
prerequisites: Thales written confirmation of PQC support and validated firmware (or approved alternative)
Core banking vendor written confirmation of compatibility (if applicable)

migration_steps.activity: Post-freeze: execute production migration of ECDH P-256 internal secure communication channels to hybrid ML-KEM+ECDH, contingent on HSM and application readiness.
prerequisites: HSM PQC support confirmed and validated

migration_steps.activity: Post-freeze: execute production migration of RSA-2048 TLS certificates to hybrid ML-KEM for key establishment and ML-DSA for signatures (as applicable), contingent on certificate authority and application support.
prerequisites: CA support for PQC certificates confirmed
Application and load balancer compatibility validated

migration_steps.activity: Post-freeze: execute production migration of ECDSA P-256 internal API authentication to hybrid ML-DSA+ECDSA, contingent on API gateway and core banking platform support.
prerequisites: Core banking vendor written confirmation of ML-DSA support

blockers.blocker: Thales has not confirmed production support, firmware compatibility, or delivery timeline for NIST-standardized ML-KEM and ML-DSA on Luna Network HSM 7.
blockers.reason: Without written confirmation, the bank cannot plan or execute production HSM firmware upgrades or rely on the HSM for PQC key establishment or signatures. This blocks production migration of any asset that depends on HSM-backed keys, including RSA-3072 key wrapping and ECDH P-256 channels.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written confirmation from Thales including: supported firmware version(s), ML-KEM and ML-DSA algorithm support, FIPS 140-3 validation status, delivery timeline, upgrade procedure, and compatibility with existing Luna 7 hardware. Validate in non-production lab before production scheduling.

blockers.blocker: Third-party core banking platform vendor has not provided written confirmation of PQC compatibility or a migration roadmap.
blockers.reason: The core banking platform likely integrates with TLS, API authentication, and key wrapping. Without vendor confirmation, the bank cannot safely migrate these assets without risking service disruption or unsupported configurations. This blocks production changes for any asset touching the core banking platform.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written confirmation from core banking vendor including: PQC roadmap, supported crypto libraries, ML-KEM/ML-DSA support timeline, API authentication compatibility, and migration guidance. If unavailable, document as accepted risk and plan compensating controls.

blockers.blocker: Production HSM firmware upgrade and any PQC-capable HSM hardware cannot be procured until vendor confirmation and budget approval for post-first-phase costs.
blockers.reason: The USD 250,000 first-phase budget is allocated to planning, lab testing, and vendor engagement. Production HSM firmware or hardware procurement may exceed this budget and cannot proceed without confirmed vendor support and additional funding approval.
blockers.resolution_required: Confirm vendor support (BLK-001), obtain cost estimate for production HSM upgrade, and secure additional budget approval if needed. Defer procurement until first-phase results are available.

blockers.blocker: Hybrid PQC interoperability and performance in the bank's specific environment (TLS terminators, load balancers, API gateways, database encryption) has not been validated.
blockers.reason: Lab testing in first phase will reduce but not eliminate uncertainty. Production migration requires validated interoperability and performance characteristics for each asset.
blockers.resolution_required: Complete lab and staging validation (steps 8, 9, 13) and obtain performance benchmarks. Confirm application and network device support for hybrid algorithms.

blockers.blocker: Mandatory infrastructure change freeze from 2026-12-01 through 2027-01-15 prohibits production cryptographic changes, HSM firmware upgrades, and major application deployments.
blockers.reason: No production migration steps can occur during this period. Only planning, documentation, vendor engagement, and permitted non-production lab activities may continue.
blockers.resolution_required: Schedule all production changes after 2027-01-15. Use freeze period for permitted non-production activities and planning.

blockers.blocker: Regulatory approval or notification requirements for PQC migration have not been confirmed with banking regulators.
blockers.reason: Banking regulators may require notification or approval for cryptographic changes affecting customer data protection. Unconfirmed regulatory position could delay production migration.
blockers.resolution_required: Engage compliance and legal teams to determine regulatory notification requirements. Obtain any necessary approvals before production changes.

vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Written confirmation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA support, firmware version, FIPS 140-3 validation certificate, delivery timeline, upgrade procedure, and compatibility with existing Luna 7 hardware. Lab validation of PQC operations on HSM.

Written confirmation of PQC roadmap, supported crypto libraries, ML-KEM/ML-DSA support timeline, API authentication compatibility, TLS configuration support, and migration guidance. Evidence of testing in comparable environments.
Written confirmation of support for PQC certificates (ML-DSA or hybrid), issuance timeline, and compatibility with bank's TLS terminators.
Documentation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA support in stable releases, with validation testing in bank lab. Note: confirmed for lab use only; production use requires validation.
